question: Let $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}1 & k \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}.$$ Find the value of $k$ for which $B$ is the inverse of $A$, and verify the result.
explanation:
Product $AB$
$$AB=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & k \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1 & k+1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}$$
For $AB=I$, $$k+1=0\Rightarrow k=-1$$
Verification of the reverse product
For $k=-1$, $$B=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}$$
and $$BA=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}=I$$
Existence of inverse
Since $AB=BA=I$, the inverse exists and $B=A^{-1}$ when $k=-1$.
